system_description.narrative_title: Markets & Geopolitics: Oil Diplomacy, Rate Risk and Tech Shock
system_description.narrative_summary: News in this window is dominated by the interaction of reducing geopolitical risk in the Middle East (pushing oil prices down) with persistent macro and policy uncertainty (central bank rate moves, inflation) and concentrated market shocks in technology and crypto (AI revaluation, large exchange heist). The result is a volatile, information-driven feedback system where commodity diplomacy, monetary policy signals, election timing, and security incidents jointly drive capital flows and investor sentiment.
system_description.scope: Global financial markets and the political‑economic interactions during Nov 1–3, 2026: oil and gas supply diplomacy, equity and crypto markets, central bank policy actions/expectations, major corporate/tech developments, and near‑term electoral/political catalysts that affect investor behaviour.
system_description.super_system: International political‑economy (global security, trade, and finance system).
evidence_headlines: Oil Drops Amid Diplomatic Efforts to Revive Mideast Peace Talks
Crude oil prices sell off more than 7% on Iran peace talk hopes ahead of U.S. midterms
Binance users pull $3.6bn as crypto exchange restarts services after heist
The AI trade has broken down. How we got here and what investors should expect next
BOE Expected to Join Peers in Raising Key Rate
Wall St futures rise as AI stocks catch their breath; midterms in focus

variables.name: Geopolitical tension level
variables.description: Measures the intensity and geographic spread of interstate and regional political-military frictions and diplomatic standoffs.

variables.name: Oil supply disruption risk
variables.description: Measures the probability and expected severity of disruptions to physical oil and gas production and transport.

variables.name: Oil price level
variables.description: Measures the prevailing global benchmark crude price level as reflected in traded markets.

variables.name: Monetary policy uncertainty
variables.description: Measures the degree of unpredictability and dispersion in expectations about central bank policy actions.

variables.name: Interest-rate expectations
variables.description: Measures the market-implied expected path of short- and medium-term interest rates.

variables.name: Inflation expectations
variables.description: Measures the expected future rate of consumer price inflation over relevant horizons.

variables.name: Technology equity valuation
variables.description: Measures valuation levels in technology-related equity markets relative to underlying earnings or fundamentals.

variables.name: Crypto market liquidity
variables.description: Measures the depth and ease of executing trades in crypto markets (available bids/asks and turnover).

variables.name: Market volatility level
variables.description: Measures realized and implied price variability across financial markets, capturing short-term risk fluctuations.

variables.name: Cross-border capital flows
variables.description: Measures net financial capital movement across jurisdictions (portfolio, bank, and other flows) per unit time.

variables.name: Investor sentiment
variables.description: Measures aggregate market risk appetite and willingness of investors to take on financial risk.

variables.name: Diplomatic engagement intensity
variables.description: Measures the frequency, scale, and scope of formal diplomatic negotiations and mediation efforts addressing geopolitical or resource disputes.

variables.name: Cybersecurity incident rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and scale of cyber intrusions and service-disrupting digital attacks affecting critical infrastructure and markets.

variables.name: Energy reserve levels
variables.description: Measures the aggregated stock of commercial and strategic energy inventories available to buffer supply shocks.

variables.name: Monetary policy stance
variables.description: Measures the tightness or looseness of overall monetary conditions, e.g., real policy rate and liquidity posture.

variables.name: Asset market concentration
variables.description: Measures the degree to which capital and trading activity are concentrated in a small number of assets, sectors, or issuers.

catalysts.title: U.S. midterm election results
catalysts.description: Final vote tallies and post-election clarity from the U.S. midterms, resolving control narratives for Congress and near-term fiscal policy expectations.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Inside the US Postal Service sprint to deliver millions of ballots' and midterms in focus.

catalysts.title: Iran-Doha peace talks (Doha rounds)
catalysts.description: Continuation or resumption of Iran-related negotiations in Doha that could reduce war risk and ease energy-market fears.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Iranians have left Doha talks, draft proposal circulated' and oil falls on peace-talk hopes.

catalysts.title: Risk of further US/Iran or regional strikes
catalysts.description: Possibility of additional strikes (e.g., reports of action on Qeshm Island) that could escalate regional tensions and disrupt energy flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'U.S. reportedly strikes Iran's Qeshm Island' amid talks—signals risk of further strikes.

catalysts.title: Bank of England November decision
catalysts.description: Imminent BoE policy meeting where a rate hike or guidance could change global rate expectations and risk pricing.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Bank of England poised to raise rates' and 'BOE expected to join peers in raising key rate.'

catalysts.title: BOJ December rate hike
catalysts.description: Planned or signalled Bank of Japan policy move in December that would mark a shift in global policy synchronisation.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'BOJ locks in December hike, but neutral-rate uncertainty muddies outlook.'

catalysts.title: Eroded global energy supply buffers
catalysts.description: Low commercial and strategic inventories and constrained spare capacity leave markets sensitive to geopolitical or production shocks.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'World's energy supply buffers have been eroded, ADNOC CEO says.'

catalysts.title: Binance outflows and hack aftermath
catalysts.description: Large user withdrawals and recovery actions at Binance could strain crypto liquidity and spill into broader market sentiment.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Binance users pull $3.6bn', 'Binance sees $3.64 billion in net outflows' after $6.3bn heist.

catalysts.title: Apple quarterly results
catalysts.description: Apple's upcoming earnings and guidance could further sway tech valuations and sector risk sentiment after heavy October weakness.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Asia stocks rise as tech gains ahead of Apple results' and 'Apple’s iPhone business is booming. Here’s why the stock is falling.'

catalysts.title: Expiry of Oleshky ceasefire / renewed fighting
catalysts.description: Expiration of the Oleshky ceasefire and evacuations in Kherson raise the prospect of renewed frontline fighting and regional escalation.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Oleshky ceasefire expires, Ukraine evacuates civilians' and reports Russia reinforcing positions.

catalysts.title: Push to restore Russian gas sales to Europe
catalysts.description: Diplomatic and commercial efforts to resume Russian gas flows to Europe through Ukraine may alter European energy availability and politics.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Exclusive | U.S. Pushes to Restore Russian Gas Sales to Europe Via Ukraine.'
